items.exampleEn: Considering the heavy traffic, we arrived quite early.
items.exampleZh: 考慮到交通這麼塞，我們算是很早到了。

items.exampleEn: She is undoubtedly the best speaker on our team.
items.exampleZh: 她無疑是我們團隊裡最會演講的人。

items.exampleEn: After the long flight, I felt utterly exhausted.
items.exampleZh: 長途飛行之後，我覺得累壞了。

items.exampleEn: Evidently, nobody had read the instructions.
He joined the company last spring and was promoted shortly thereafter.
items.exampleZh: 他去年春天進公司，不久之後就升職了。

items.exampleEn: Firstly, it is cheap. Secondly, it is easy to use.
items.exampleZh: 第一，它很便宜。第二，它很好用。

items.exampleEn: There is scarcely any milk left in the fridge.
items.exampleZh: 冰箱裡幾乎沒剩牛奶了。

items.sentenceEn: Considering his experience, he asked for a fair salary.
items.sentenceZh: 考慮到他的經驗，他要求的薪水很合理。

items.audioEn: There are two problems. Firstly, the printer is broken. Secondly, we have no paper.
items.audioZh: 有兩個問題。第一，印表機壞了。第二，我們沒有紙了。

items.sentenceEn: The new design is utterly different from the old one.
items.sentenceZh: 新設計和舊的完全不同。

items.sentenceEn: We had scarcely started the meeting when the lights went out.
items.sentenceZh: 會議才剛開始，燈就熄了。

items.stemEn: The room was so dark that I could ____ see my own hands.
items.stemZh: 房間暗到我幾乎看不見自己的手。

items.stemEn: Everyone loves it. The new phone is ____ the best one on the market this year.
items.stemZh: 大家都很喜歡。這支新手機無疑是今年市面上最好的。

items.passageEn: Last month, our team stayed at a new hotel for a three-day training course. Considering the low price, we did not expect much. However, the rooms were undoubtedly clean and comfortable. There were only two problems. Firstly, the internet was slow. Secondly, the restaurant closed at eight, so we could scarcely find dinner after our evening classes. The manager evidently heard our complaints on the first night, because the next day the kitchen stayed open until ten. Thereafter, everything went smoothly. By the end of the course, we were utterly exhausted but happy, and we all agreed to come back next year.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們團隊住進一家新飯店，參加為期三天的訓練課程。考慮到價格很低，我們本來沒有太大期待。不過，房間無疑既乾淨又舒適。只有兩個問題。第一，網路很慢。第二，餐廳八點就關了，所以晚上上完課後我們幾乎找不到晚餐吃。經理顯然在第一晚聽到了我們的抱怨，因為隔天廚房開到十點。此後一切都很順利。課程結束時，我們累壞了但很開心，大家都同意明年還要再來。

questions.questionZh: 這家飯店有哪兩個問題？
options: 房間不乾淨、價格又太高
離市區太遠、沒有停車位

questions.questionZh: 第二天飯店做了什麼改變？

items.promptZh: 考慮到他才剛進公司，他表現得非常好。
referenceEn: Considering he has just joined the company, he is doing very well.
He is doing a great job, considering that he is new here.
rubricZh: considering 後面可接子句或名詞（例如 considering (that) he…、considering his short time here）
「表現得非常好」可寫 do very well、do a great job 等，時態用現在式或現在進行式都可以

items.instructionZh: 用 thereafter 造一個句子，說說你做了某件事之後接著發生的事。
referenceEn: I moved to Taichung in May and found a new job shortly thereafter.
I started running every morning, and thereafter I felt much healthier.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 thereafter，表示「在那之後」（例如 shortly thereafter、and thereafter…）
前後兩件事要有時間先後，而且是在說你自己的經歷
